Where the Butterflies Turn Black.text: Close your eyes, the night is calling
Through a world where stars are falling
Little wings of pink and gold
Lead me somewhere strange and old
Every time I fall asleep
There's another world beneath
Strange horizons, skies unknown
Never a place to call my own
Pink-winged wishes fill the air
Fragile dreams are everywhere
I follow where the petals fly
Beneath a painted, sleeping sky
But something moves beneath the light
The flowers close, the stars lose sight
A crooked shadow stains the blue
And suddenly, the world feels new
Where the butterflies turn black
There's no easy turning back
Velvet wings and liquid skies
Hide the fear behind their eyes
I will find where it began
Trace the cracks with trembling hands
Through the dream and through the dark
Where the butterflies turn black
The walls are breathing, trees have eyes
The ground rewrites its own design
Blackened wings begin to crawl
Something's waiting past it all
Little footsteps by my side
Keep me tethered through the night
When the world forgets what's real
You're the one thing I can feel
I never asked to cross these skies
Or wear the fear behind their eyes
I only seek the breaking thread
Before the dream consumes what's left
Where the butterflies turn black
There's no easy turning back
Velvet wings and liquid skies
Hide the fear behind their eyes
I will find where it began
Trace the cracks with trembling hands
Through the dream and through the dark
Where the butterflies turn black
Am I awake? Am I asleep?
How many worlds are left to keep?
I've walked through dreams that weren't my own
And still have never found my home
If every dream must fade away
What will be left of me someday?
A thousand doors, a thousand skies
And not one place where I reside
Where the butterflies turn black
I keep searching through the cracks
Even when the light has died
I won't leave the lost behind
Every dream and every scar
Every world, no matter how far
I'll keep walking through the dark
Where the butterflies turn black
Close your eyes, the night is deep
Someone else's dream awaits me
But somewhere there's a dream unknown...
A dream that never calls me home.

The Girl Between Dreams.text: The hallway narrows, lights grow dim
I don't remember entering in
A distant bell rings once, then twice
The walls blink back with borrowed eyes
The staircase ends against a wall
I hear a voice beyond it call
I follow it through peeling paint
The air grows thick, the lights grow faint
A doorway opens to the sea
The waves climb up the barren trees
I turn to find the way I came
The shore is gone, the walls have changed
Every turn erases where I've been
Every shadow lets another in
I tell myself the worst has passed
Then something moves behind the glass
Every time I turn around
The world has changed its face again
A silent scream, a shifting ground
A nightmare waiting round the bend
I run, it moves, I lose my way
The walls fold in, the lights decay
I turn around, there's something there
Another nightmare, another snare
A nursery drowned in midnight rain
A hundred dolls repeat my name
Their little heads begin to turn
Their painted smiles refuse to blur
The ceiling sinks, the floor gives way
The stairs twist back the way they came
I find a window, pull the frame
There's only darkness there again
The footsteps stop when I stand still
Then start again against my will
I hold my breath, I count to three
Something counts along with me
Every time I turn around
The world has changed its face again
A silent scream, a shifting ground
A nightmare waiting round the bend
I run, it moves, I lose my way
The walls fold in, the lights decay
I turn around, there's something there
Another nightmare, another snare
For one still moment, nothing moves
No distant cries, no changing rooms
I almost dare to take a breath
To trust the quiet, welcome rest
A footstep sounds behind my own
A voice whispers in a voice I know
I turn before it says my name—
And nothing here is quite the same
Every time I turn around
Another world comes crashing in
The sky falls down without a sound
And something stirs beneath my skin
No path to follow, no way through
No time to learn what waits ahead
I turn, and all the walls are new
I turn, and find another dread
The bell rings once
The lights go out
I hear it breathing
All around
I turn my head—
Another nightmare.

Never Out of Sight.text: Morning spills across the floor
Golden light beneath the door
Little flowers turn my way
Like they know I'm here to stay
Crystal petals fill the air
Tiny bells are everywhere
Every path is painted bright
Every step feels soft and light
I follow ribbons through the trees
They dance along the summer breeze
I don't know where they might go
For once, I don't need to know
Maybe I could stay awhile
Follow every winding mile
No need to wonder where I'll be
I'll follow where it carries me
Round and round, the colors fly
Little stars across the sky
Every road feels warm and bright
I'm never out of sight
Take my hand and lead me through
Every shade of pink and blue
I don't need to know what's right
I'm never out of sight
Didn't I pass that tree before?
Was there always one more door?
I could swear the flowers stare
I turn around—there's nothing there
The ribbons pull a little tight
I tell myself it's still all right
I choose the left, I swear I do
My feet still take me somewhere new
Maybe I should stop awhile
Why have I walked another mile?
I know I meant to turn back there
...Didn't I?
Round and round, the colors fly
I don't know the reason why
Every road bends left and right
Leading back into its sight
Take my hand—no, set me free
This isn't where I chose to be
Left or right, I try, I fight
I'm never out of sight
There's something strange about my hands
They move before I understand
One little step, another two
I can't tell what I chose to do
An unseen thread is pulling tight
It guides me farther from the light
I reach for it—there's nothing there
Just empty fingers, empty air
Don't turn around
Don't make a sound
Don't let it know
I know it now
The pretty world
The gentle light
Was never there to keep me safe
It only kept me in its sight
If I stand still, will it wait?
If I close my eyes, will it fade?
If I don't move, if I don't breathe
Could it forget that it sees me?
One...
Two...
Three...
Nothing.
I open my eyes.
The flowers are looking at me.
Round and round, the colors die
No more stars are in the sky
Every road bends left and right
To keep me always in its sight
Cut the thread, I feel it strain
I try to run, it pulls again
Every door, every turn, every night
Still it keeps me in its sight
Never hidden
Never free
Nowhere it cannot follow me
I was never out of sight
The ribbons sway
Though all is still
The flowers turn
Against my will
I don't know where I'm going now
Yet something knows the way somehow.
